name: Sumifa
description: The capital of Almaaz, rebuilt almost 1300 years after its fall in the Brothers' War.

description_citations.text: "Terisian Isles". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Almaazan songmages of Sumifa surrender to Mishra and offer their powers to the Fallaji Empire to avoid destruction.
timeline.quote: surrendered to Mishra and offered their powers to the Fallaji Empire in the war to avoid the destruction of their nation

citation.text: "Almaaz", section "The Brothers' War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Mishra sends Ashnod to Almaaz to oversee iron and lumber harvesting; civil war breaks out after the Fall of Sumifa.
timeline.quote: although civil war eventually broke out after the Fall of Sumifa

citation.text: "Almaaz", section "The Brothers' War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A new Sumifa is founded around 1300 AR.
timeline.quote: Around 1300 AR, a new city of the same name was built not far from the first city's site.

citation.text: "Sumifa", section ""New" Sumifa". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After the Fall of Sumifa in the Brothers' War, a new city of the same name is built almost 1300 years later.
timeline.quote: a new city of the same name was built after almost 1300 years.

citation.text: "Terisian Isles", section "Almaaz". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During the Ice Age the Rigida rule most of Almaaz and the Great Glacier buries the west; a new Sumifa is established in 1300 AR.
timeline.quote: In 1300 AR , a new Sumifa was established slightly west of the original site of old Sumifa.

citation.text: "Almaaz", section "The Ice Age". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After the Flooding of Terisiare, Almaaz's rule is reestablished with Sumifa as capital; in 3050 AR the buried ruins of old Sumifa are found.
timeline.quote: In 3050 AR , the buried ruins of old Sumifa were found in the desert.

citation.text: "Almaaz", section "After the Thaw". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

pages_say.description: The capital of Almaaz, destroyed in the Brothers' War and rebuilt about 1300 years later slightly west of the original site.

citation.text: "Almaaz". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
